title: Maximum Profit Of Operating A Centennial Wheel
description: Calculate the maximum profit of a Ferris wheel by boarding groups of up to 4 people, charging $a$ per person, and paying $b$ to run the wheel.

steps.note: Initialize boarding process for first group
Add 8 customers to queue, board 4 people
Process next rotation, 4 remain from first group + 3 new
Board 4 people from the remaining queue
Remaining people queue is 3, process last rotation
